context: Asuka and Riku watch a nature documentary.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: nature discussion; vocabulary (太陽/巨大/見事/低/石) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先生、この山、すごく巨大ですね!
lines.style: amazed teen boy voice, soft warm wonder engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、巨大な岩が積み重なっています。
lines.en: Yes, massive rocks are piled up.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 太陽の光が、石を照らして見事ですね。
lines.en: The sunlight on the stones is splendid.
lines.style: impressed teen boy voice, soft warm admiring throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 見事な眺めですね。太陽の角度が低いです。
lines.en: A splendid view. The sun's angle is low.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 低い太陽だと、影が長いですね。
lines.en: With a low sun, the shadows are long.
lines.style: observant teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: その石は、長い年月で削られました。
lines.en: Those stones were carved over long ages.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 自然の力って、見事ですね。
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, soft warm wonder throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 巨大な自然の前では、人は小さいですね。
lines.en: Before vast nature, humans are small.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured reflective closing clarity throughout
